officialText:
Nonflammable medical and nonmedical gas systems shall be designed and installed in accordance with NFPA 99.

Exceptions:

1. This section shall not apply to portable systems or cylinder storage.

2. Vacuum system exhaust terminations shall comply with the New York City Mechanical Code.
